Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 15
Reason for Mistake: Introduced an incorrect DuckDuckGo “Search Assist” snippet claiming the paternal grandfather was Louis Jean Marie de Bourbon, confusing the Penthièvre title holder (a paternal great-grandfather via the paternal grandmother’s line) with the actual paternal grandfather, Louis Philippe II, Duke of Orléans. This reflects overreliance on an auto-generated snippet without immediate cross-verification and could mislead the solution.
